payload.title: Auritus: narration for your pages on a GPU you run
payload.description: Auritus is live at aurit.us: an open-source (MIT) embed that narrates a page's content with an open TTS model, synthesized on a GPU you run, with AWS Batch as fallback. Anth.us has no article or platform page about it, and it's one of three products Ryan wants ad campaigns for. Story shape: the plain fact first (what a reader hears when they press play on an Auritus page), the choice (your own GPU first, cloud only when it's offline; the page content never goes to a TTS vendor), then the checkable details from the README: six backends (Kokoro, Qwen 3 CustomVoice, F5-TTS, Higgs Audio v3, Chatterbox, Fish Speech), the 15-minute claim timeout, the private signed audio URL. Honest limits: the CLI isn't on PyPI yet. Close on the product site and the engage page. Source: github.com/AnthusAI/Auritus README and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
